description: Land Title Settlement Department - Settlement Orders No. 20 (Jaffna) Iyakkachchi, Pachchilaippalli D/S Division, Jaffna District, Village Plan No. 82 (North)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically addressing the final settlement of multiple land lots in Jaffna District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels being settled to "The State" or noted as "Not Claimed by the State," which falls under land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters - all characteristic of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
